bf01Finding3.reportSource: BF-PRE-REVIEW-01 handoff, independent review of PR #254; beta-finish-line.md "BF-04"
bf01Finding3.reproduction: Base production build QOm9tykat3tn1JV4fGe1- (b85da4a0): abort **/anatomy/larynx/**, reach S9 Part 3 (failed), Use the schematic view, restore the route, Try the 3D view again -> data-three-state="loading" for 30 s. Also: after repeated failures and a restored route, Reload the 3D view -> loading for 30 s.
bf01Finding3.rootCause: ScopeScenePane attaches the playback element to a different node in the 3D branch and the schematic branch. useScopePlayback bound its IntersectionObserver in an effect keyed on the ref object, so after the switch it still observed the removed node, which reports isIntersecting=false. visible stayed false, the canvas frameloop stayed "never", no frame was drawn and onDraw never fired. The BF-01 handoff's source-level hypothesis is confirmed at browser level.
repair: useScopePlayback takes the mounted element (state), so the observer rebinds when the element changes.

components/scope/sceneLoad.ts: the scene's load is one reducer (loading | ready | failed; attempt, autoRecoveries, failure). The learner's retry is a new attempt; a lost graphics context is recovered at most 2 times per attempt, then fails; an attempt not drawn after 45 s on screen in a visible tab fails with the retry and the schematic view offered. A frame drawn after a failure does not make the view ready.
forgetPendingScopeModels(): a new attempt re-requests model files whose earlier request never settled; loaded models stay cached.
While the controls wait for the first frame the dock says so.
bf01Finding3.observedAfter: failure -> schematic -> Try the 3D view again -> ready; three failed retries each return to failed (never loading), then a restored route draws; a hung request fails at the deadline (data-three-failure="deadline") and the next reload draws (data-three-attempt="1").
preserved: No scope reducer, clock, goal, interlock or accessory code changed
Controls open only on a drawn frame or in the schematic view, as before
A background tab and an offscreen pane still accrue no simulated time and do not count toward the deadline
PR #291: one bench presentation for the scene and the end-on drawing; its suites pass
